fallback_defaults.description: Any section, module, card, chip, or UI surface lacking explicit domain or section tagging inherits brand orange (#ff6b35) as its accent pointer.

bg.role: Root page canvas and base underlay.

surface.role: Standard container, card fill, and default panel elevation.

surface_elevated.role: Hover card fills, popovers, dropdowns, and nested inputs.

line.role: Standard perimeter borders, structural dividers, and card outlines.

line_strong.role: Interactive element borders, table header divides, and focused outlines.

line_soft.role: Internal card hairlines and meta chip separators.

heading.role: High-contrast h1, h2, and h3 titles.

text.role: High-emphasis narrative body text, focused card content, and summaries.

text_body.role: Standard definition body text, data cells, and secondary descriptions.

muted.role: Example sentences, rank outlines, date pills, and secondary keys.

faint.role: Footer colophons, disabled states, and subtle meta counters.

brand_mandarin.role: Primary brand anchor, student todo markers, and fallback accent.

brand_deep.role: Dark gradient bottom stop and shadow tinting.

brand_soft.role: Tinted badge fills and soft highlighted surfaces.

indicator_rail.background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--accent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 42%, #000))

agent_execution_rules: Rule 1: All documents must render standalone without dependencies on external CSS stylesheets or Tailwind CDNs.
Rule 2: Never place any text or meta label below 13px.
Rule 3: Section-specific styling must be driven by parent CSS variable inheritance (--accent: [HUE]) scoped on the wrapping section element.
Rule 4: Card indicator bars must be 3px wide and use the vertical gradient: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--accent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 42%, #000)).
